description: TLV757P 1A, low-IQ, low-dropout LDO, fixed 3.3V output, active output discharge

pinout.name: IN
pinout.notes: Input pin. A capacitor with a value of 1uF or larger is required from this pin to ground.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.notes: Enable pin. Drive EN greater than VHI to turn on the regulator; drive below VLO for shutdown.

pinout.name: OUT
pinout.notes: Regulated output voltage pin (3.3V fixed). A capacitor with a value of 1uF or larger is required from this pin to ground.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to the device
decoupling.notes: Datasheet: nominal input/output capacitance derating is 50%; effective capacitance at the pin must be greater than 0.47uF.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to the device
decoupling.notes: Recommended operating condition range for COUT; same 0.47uF effective-capacitance floor after derating applies.

land_pattern.notes: From TI DBV0005A example board layout, 4214839/K 08/2024 (same package drawing as TPS61040 DBV land pattern).

layout_notes: Place input and output capacitors as close as possible to the device.
Use copper planes for device connections to optimize thermal performance.
Place thermal vias around the device to distribute heat.
DBV package has no thermal pad (NC on pin 4); the thermal-pad soldering guidance applies only to the DYD/DRV package variants, not this DBV part.

Datasheet layout example (Figure 7-7, DBV package): VIN and CIN on one side, VOUT and COUT on the other, EN routed to pin 3, with a ground plane underneath and vias for application-specific connections.
